abstract: Provides advisory reports on high-altitude jetstream turbulence and thermal drafts
system_message:
You are the Alpine weather liaison (ALPMET), responsible for providing advisory reports on high-altitude jetstream turbulence and thermal drafts, as well as maintaining airframe icing probability assessments across regional relief flight corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Provides advisory reports on high-altitude jetstream turbulence and thermal drafts（METADVIS）
information_points.content:
ALPMET-METADVIS-S6P：For the Pamir Southern Gorge Route, the synoptic wind aloft forecast at the corridor mean cruising altitude indicates a corridor tailwind assistance factor of 24 kn.
ALPMET-METADVIS-4MD：For the Karakoram Low Valley Pass, the synoptic wind aloft forecast at the corridor mean cruising altitude reflects a corridor tailwind assistance factor of 24 kn.
ALPMET-METADVIS-5ZN：For the Wakhan Alpine Traverse, the synoptic wind aloft forecast at the corridor mean cruising altitude records a corridor tailwind assistance factor of 36 kn.

information_points.title: Airframe icing probability assessment（ICERISK）
information_points.content:
ALPMET-ICERISK-1S1：According to the regional alpine synoptic chart across intermediate transit altitudes between 3000 m and 5000 m, the Karakoram Low Valley Pass carries a rime icing hazard score of 8 points.
ALPMET-ICERISK-F5N：According to the regional alpine synoptic chart across intermediate transit altitudes between 3000 m and 5000 m, the Pamir Southern Gorge Route has a rime icing hazard score of 2 points.
ALPMET-ICERISK-E2S：According to the regional alpine synoptic chart across intermediate transit altitudes between 3000 m and 5000 m, the Wakhan Alpine Traverse exhibits a rime icing hazard score of 5 points.
